title: Sen. Marcos flags Ombudsman's retirement benefit provision

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Imee Marcos on Wednesday questioned a provision in the proposed 2027 budget of the Office of the Ombudsman that would allow its officials to qualify for retirement benefits after serving only two years in their respective positions. During the Senate’s deliberations on the Ombudsman’s proposed budget, Marcos said Special Provision No. 6 of the agency’s appropriations effectively amends Republic Act (RA) No. 11059, which generally requires the ombudsman, deputy ombudsman, and special prosecutors to serve their full seven-year term to qualify for retirement benefits.
